outline:
本課程旨在介紹研究快速原型之原理與方法，並藉設計實例演練，以達熟悉研究快速原型之操作與功能。
To introduce and study the principle and method of rapid prototype.  By the design project practice, to be adept at the operation and function of rapid prototype.
schedule:
1. Introduction to Course Aims and Contents
2. Product Design and Prototype-Why need prototype
3. Rapid Prototype Basic
4. Classification of RP systems
5. RP and Applications
6. Rapid Prototyping Advanced Techniques
7. 3D CAD-Modeling Skills
8. 3D CAD-Modeling Skills
9. 3D CAD-Modeling Skills
10. 3D CAD-Modeling Skills
11. CAD Data Exchange-The format of STL
12. Extending Technology-Micro RP
13. Extending Technology-Rapid Tooling
14. Project Design of Rapid Prototyping
15. Project Design of Rapid Prototyping
16. Project Design of Rapid Prototyping
17. Project Design of Rapid Prototyping
18.  Presentation of Final Project
assessment:
專題製作：50％
一般作業：30
平時考評：20％
